name: Benjiro Minesuga
source:
Benjiro is a naive and underdeveloped boy, having spent his life sheltered in the rural countryside. Born deformed to an influential family, his existence was kept a secret from everyone; leaving him to be raised and educated by nannies. Apathy didn't deter Benjiro however, and he found friends in the critters met on his many adventures, learning to communicate and bond with the local population of bees. Now they protect him like one of their own, and Benjiro is never left feeling lonely.
